pilot_live_probe_ledger.name: Pilot Live Provider Probe Ledger
pilot_live_probe_ledger.purpose: Exploratory pilot evaluating latency, format compliance, error taxonomy, and router routing behavior across 3 live provider models (not a confirmatory prospective equivalence study)
pilot_live_probe_ledger.power_assessment: Underpowered (N=8 < 384); TOST p-value reported as NaN/None rather than claiming equivalence. The full prospective cohort requires N=384 powered observations.

full_prospective_powered_cohort.name: Full Prospective Powered Cohort
full_prospective_powered_cohort.purpose: Powered biostatistical equivalence testing under Schuirmann TOST
full_prospective_powered_cohort.power_assessment: Powered for equivalence within +/- 2 percentage points (delta=0.02, alpha=0.05)
